mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle_history ( vehicle_history_id, vehicle_id, office_id, vehicle_number, vehicle_model, owner_name, vehicle_type_code, registration_type_code, registration_status_code, registered_at, rejected_reason, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, changed_by_admin_id, actor_type_code, actor_id, change_type_code, change_reason, valid_from, valid_to ) VALUES ( seq_vehicle_history.NEXTVAL, #{vehicleid}, #{officeid}, #{vehiclenumber}, #{vehiclemodel}, #{ownername}, #{vehicletypecode}, #{registrationtypecode}, #{registrationstatuscode}, #{registeredat}, #{rejectedreason}, #{createdat}, #{updatedat}, #{deletedat}, #{changedbyadminid}, #{actortypecode}, #{actorid}, #{changetypecode}, #{changereason}, SYSDATE, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT vehicle_history_id AS vehiclehistoryid, vehicle_id AS vehicleid, office_id AS officeid, vehicle_number AS vehiclenumber, vehicle_model AS vehiclemodel, owner_name AS ownername, vehicle_type_code AS vehicletypecode, registration_type_code AS registrationtypecode, registration_status_code AS registrationstatuscode, registered_at AS registeredat, rejected_reason AS rejectedreason, created_at AS createdat, updated_at AS updatedat, deleted_at AS deletedat, changed_by_admin_id AS changedbyadminid, actor_type_code AS actortypecode, actor_id AS actorid, change_type_code AS changetypecode, change_reason AS changereason, valid_from AS validfrom, valid_to AS validto FROM vehicle_history ORDER BY valid_from DESC, vehicle_history_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE vehicle_history SET valid_to = SYSDATE WHERE vehicle_id = #{vehicleid} AND valid_to IS NULL
